title: Practice 7: Numerals, nouns and adjectives together

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: На улице два ___ (автомобиль): красный и серебристый.
exercises.prompt: There are two cars on the street: a red one and a silver one.
exercises.why: **два автомобиля** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (автомобиль → автомобиля).
**тринадцать пассажирок** — 5–20, 25–30, 35–40… take the genitive plural (пассажирка → пассажирок).

exercises.prompt: Yes, it is. There's a lot of moisture in the air.
exercises.why: **много влаги** — много with something you cannot count takes the genitive singular (влага → влаги).

exercises.q: Том обвёл в кружок три ___ (имя) в списке.
exercises.prompt: Tom circled three names on the list.
exercises.why: **три имени** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (имя → имени).

exercises.prompt: I have a lot of expenses.
exercises.why: **много расходов** — много with something you can count takes the genitive plural (расход → расходов).

exercises.prompt: I see a lot of hypocrisy.
exercises.why: **много лицемерия** — много with something you cannot count takes the genitive singular (лицемерие → лицемерия).

exercises.prompt: Nouns in Latin have five declensions.
exercises.why: **пять склонений** — 5–20, 25–30, 35–40… take the genitive plural (склонение → склонений).

exercises.prompt: The plan has many practical difficulties.
exercises.why: **много практических сложностей** — много with something you can count takes the genitive plural (практический сложность → практических сложностей).

exercises.prompt: How many hairs are there in a cat's tail?
exercises.why: **сколько шерстинок** — сколько with something you can count takes the genitive plural (шерстинка → шерстинок).
